subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` default to recovery-first after an accepted Gateway disconnect, and if recovery cannot establish an outcome should it automatically use an isolated rerun or fail closed unless the user opts in?
rationale: This is a user-facing compatibility choice between timely fallback output, authoritative-result recovery, duplicated side-effect risk, and `--deliver` behavior; source review cannot safely select that product contract.

options.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
options.body: Wait and cache-replay the original run first, then retain the existing fresh-session fallback only after recovery becomes unknown or exhausts.

options.title: Adopt recovery-first and fail closed
options.body: Return an actionable unknown-outcome error after recovery is exhausted and require an explicit user opt-in before any rerun can occur.

options.title: Retain immediate isolated fallback
options.body: Keep current main behavior and substantially narrow or close this PR because the changed interaction contract is not desired.

recommendation.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Wait and cache-replay the original run first, then retain the existing fresh-session fallback only after recovery becomes unknown or exhausts.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current fresh-session fallback contract and are the clearest history-backed owner for its successor behavior.
